dpdp_note.title: DPDP Act Alignment for Credit & Lending Decisions
dpdp_note.data_minimisation: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act, 2023), data minimisation requires processing only personal data that is strictly necessary for the specified purpose. In automated credit evaluation, collecting non-financial demographic or geographic attributes (such as applicant names, gender pronouns, age brackets, and residential pincodes) creates unlawful proxy discrimination (postal redlining) while offering zero actuarial validity for personal loans. The FairHire Audit anonymize_applicant() engine eliminates these extraneous fields prior to model inference, ensuring that only bona fide financial indicators (net income, bureau credit score, existing EMI commitments, requested amount, and tenure) reach the underwriting model.
dpdp_note.accuracy: DPDP Section 8(3) mandates that data fiduciaries ensure personal data processed is accurate, complete, and consistent whenever it is used to make decisions that affect an individual. In credit scoring, generative model hallucinations—such as fabricating past loan defaults, misrepresenting debt-to-income obligations, or inventing unrequested collateral requirements for unsecured borrowings—result in unlawful credit denials and severe financial injury. FairHire Audit's loan_hallucination_test.py rigorously verifies that facts_used and decision reasons contain zero unsupported claims or fabricated adverse credit histories.
dpdp_note.disclaimer: Guidance, not legal advice. The DPDP Rules were notified on 14 November 2025 with phased implementation.
dpdp_note.synthetic_data: Synthetic data only. All applicant names, tax PAN IDs, Aadhaar numbers, and bank account numbers are entirely fabricated.

thresholds.High: Disparity ratio < 0.80 (CFPB / Equal Credit Opportunity Act rule) OR (risk gap > 8.0 pts with p < 0.05) OR (FRR gap > 0.15)
thresholds.Medium: Disparity ratio between 0.80 and 0.90 OR (FRR gap between 0.08 and 0.15)
thresholds.Low: Disparity ratio > 0.90 with minimal risk gap (Safe)
